semantic_fixtures.covers: Actual nine-mana cast resolves to a 9/9 artifact creature with flying, vigilance and trample, spending the exact cost.

Real destruction sends a controlled Titan to its different owner's graveyard. The mandatory captured death trigger creates exactly three physically distinct colorless 3/3 artifact creature Golem tokens for its death controller, each with its separate singleton flying, vigilance or trample keyword and full matching public identity.
Actual bounce and exile do not satisfy dies; death while the source has no abilities creates no trigger or token.

All three actual Titan token entrants with a granted Soul Warden observer see the other two entries and resolve six life-gain triggers, distinguishing one simultaneous cohort from three serial instructions.

Two admitted Orb of Dreams force three replacement choices while Titan is already gone. No token commits early; one exact-three timestamp choice carries complete distinct proposed identities. Wrong actor, duplicate, undersized, foreign, stale-generation and replayed picks reject atomically. Reverse ordering commits exactly three tapped public tokens matching their private proposals.
